target.statement: Llama-2-7b-CoH achieves Hits@1 of 0.527 on the YAGO dataset under the raw setting (Table 3).

compute.basis: Fine-tuning Llama-2-7b with LoRA on YAGO (161k training instances) and evaluating on 20k test queries requires a GPU; on CPU it would be prohibitively slow, and the paper itself uses 4x RTX 4090.

blockers: No code or data links provided in the paper
Requires implementing the full pipeline (history construction, LoRA fine-tuning, beam search inference) from scratch
Fine-tuning a 7B LLM is not feasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours
title: Chain of History: Learning and Forecasting with LLMs for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
